Thanks Sofia — read the redlines and broker note. Short answer: we can accept a blanket Additional Insured endorsement for subcontractors, provided the endorsement:

- expressly names "Redwood Inference, its officers, directors, employees and agents" as Additional Insureds;
- extends the Additional Insured status to liability arising out of the subcontractor's work for NimbleTech (not general "operations" unrelated to the order form); and
- includes a primary and non-contributory clause where feasible for third-party liability tied to the services.

Waiver of Subrogation: acceptable in principle but only to the extent permitted by the carrier and subject to Redwood's right to recovery against third parties that cause gross negligence or willful misconduct. If the carrier refuses to extend a full waiver in favor of NimbleTech, a limited waiver tied to contract performance is acceptable.

Practical ask for the broker / carrier: please provide either
- the carrier's blanket Additional Insured endorsement language (PDF image of endorsement), or
- the CG-type endorsement form number the carrier will issue, plus a copy of the insurance binder/COI showing the endorsement has been attached.

If they can also provide the COI using Redwood's COI template (I attached a short template below), that will speed review. If the carrier insists on not listing subcontractors by name, the blanket endorsement + clear endorsement language is sufficient.

Marcus — flagging potential operational note: if the endorsement limits AI to "operations" language, ensure our Order Form mapping to the SOW ties work scope to the endorsement so coverage matches the services.
